PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1928/27 – FRIDAY, AUGUST 21, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.:4/2/1/82. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2013/HW/527.

I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquistion (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Lot No. 1 to 18 allotments below name land, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3952, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Dekatana in the Grama Niladari Division of No. 401A Parangoda in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dompe, in the District of Gampaha in Western Province.
